title: Chronic kidney disease: stage, hypertension and dialysis status
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow-up for chronic kidney disease.

HPI
The patient is an 89-year-old woman who presents today for a scheduled follow-up regarding her chronic kidney disease. She reports feeling generally well and denies any new symptoms such as peripheral edema, fatigue, or changes in urine output. She has been adherent to her current medication regimen and reports no side effects. Her most recent lab work shows an eGFR of 52 mL/min/1.73m², which confirms her status of CKD. She expresses understanding of her condition and wishes to continue her current management plan.

Medication List
Lisinopril 10mg daily
Hydrochlorothiazide 12.5mg daily

Exam
The patient is alert and oriented to person, place, and time. Her skin is dry but intact. Blood pressure is 132/78 mmHg. Heart rate is 72 bpm. Lungs are clear to auscultation. No pedal edema is noted.

Assessment
1. Chronic kidney disease, stage 3a.

Plan
We will continue the current medication regimen. The patient will return in six months for a follow-up laboratory evaluation to monitor her renal function and electrolytes.

Electronically signed, P. O'Brien, MD, 05/14/2026

distractors.why: Stage 3a is documented; do not use unspecified stage 3.
